title: Social Security trust fund projected to be exhausted in 2032, CBO says
discussion_signal: The post turns the projected 2032 trust-fund exhaustion date into a public argument about retirement security, Medicare, mandatory spending, and the absence of a single prescribed policy solution. It preserves the distinction between a financing deadline and the political choices available before it.
linked_research_question: How does a projected institutional deadline reshape intergenerational security, political urgency, and the meaning of a social contract?
limits: The post summarizes a forecast rather than measuring public opinion
The exhaustion date is conditional on current-law assumptions
Discussion does not establish which reform path is politically feasible
